title: Community Housing Partners Energy Solutions
description: No-cost home weatherization and energy efficiency upgrades including insulation, HVAC, LED lighting, air/duct sealing to reduce utility bills.

title: Habitat for Humanity DC-NOVA Home Repair
organization: Habitat for Humanity of Washington DC and Northern VA
description: Partners with TruBlue to provide repairs for low-income seniors to age safely in place or address home hazards. Up to $2,500 in repairs.

title: Rebuilding Together - AFF
description: Free health, safety repairs and accessibility modifications for low/moderate-income homeowners including ramps, stairlifts, appliances, HVAC.

title: Energy Assistance Program
description: Helps with heating costs, heating emergencies, security deposits, heating equipment repair/replacement, and cooling assistance for eligible households.

title: Virginia Housing Accessibility Grants
description: Up to $8,000 for accessibility projects: ramps, chairlifts, remote entry devices, bathroom/kitchen modifications, widening doorways/sidewalks.

title: Virginia Livable Home Tax Credit
organization: Virginia Department of Housing and Community Development
description: State tax credits up to $6,500 for purchasing/constructing accessible residences or up to 50% cost (max $6,500) for retrofitting existing units.

title: Fairfax County Universal Design Permitting
description: Assists with permitting for Universal Design modifications to make your home fit your life at every stage and situation.

title: Fairfax County Manufactured Home Repair Program
organization: Good Shepherd Housing and Family Services, Inc
description: Up to $10,000 for essential repairs for low/moderate-income manufactured homeowners at Harmony Place earning up to 80% AMI.

title: Shepherd's Center of Fairfax-Burke Handy Helpers
description: Free minor home repairs and limited yard work for older adults. Client provides materials and supplies. Serves Fairfax, Burke, and South County.

title: Shepherd's Center of McLean-Arlington-Falls Church Handy Helpers
description: Volunteers assist with basic household chores like changing light bulbs, hanging pictures, or light yard work for older adults.

title: Shepherd's Center of Northern Virginia Handy Helpers
description: Free minor home repairs and limited yard work for older adults in Oakton-Vienna-Reston-Herndon-Great Falls. Client provides materials.
